## Activity

West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 385 captures during May 2022. This represents the total capture activity reported for the month. The activity figure provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes during the reporting period.

## Image quality

Of the 385 captures, 11 were marked ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.9. These images could not be used for grading and are reported separately from images that progressed to assessment. No new equipment faults were raised by staff during the month.

## Grading

A total of 88 results were graded referable. The median lag for grading was 23. This is the midpoint of the reported grading interval for the month. The activity, image quality and grading figures should be considered together when reviewing service performance at West Gate Eye Clinic for May 2022.
